body.statement: Under the latent-index model, existential rank similarity, and the full-support condition equating the complier and population potential-outcome supports, Marx's Proposition 5 gives the sharp attainable interval for the counterfactual average at every fixed policy propensity, with endpoints equal to its displayed uniformly sharp lower and upper bounds.
